## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (e.g. `fix(insert): restore image clipboard`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (written first for new behavior and bug fixes)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` pass
- [ ] Docs updated (README, CONTRIBUTING, `docs/`) where behavior or setup changed
- [ ] If platform-specific code changed, I noted which OSes I tested on
